bowaimbot.note: Bow and arrow-loaded crossbow modes each hit and killed a stationary pig at about 16 blocks in a local 26.3 multiplayer world. Firework mode remains untested; see docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-projectile-aim.md.

projectileaimbot.note: Snowball mode hit a stationary blaze at about 12 blocks, reducing health from 20 to 17. Other weapon modes remain untested in gameplay; see docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-projectile-aim.md.

autoshoot.note: With stone selected and snowballs in the next hotbar slot, Auto Shoot selected, aimed, and threw without user input until it killed a stationary blaze at about 12 blocks; see docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-autoshoot.md.

autobow.note: Auto Bow selected weapons from the hotbar, charged and fired a bow and crossbow, and threw a trident without manual input. Both shots killed pigs at 16 blocks; the trident reduced a pig to 2 health. Each run restored the stone slot. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-autobow.md. Reduced bow charge, pre-charged crossbows, and moving targets remain untested.

autoexp.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, six XP bottles repaired a Mending iron helmet from damage 100 to 24, then stopped; a non-Mending helmet consumed none. Six offhand bottles repaired a held Mending iron pickaxe from damage 100 to 20. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-autoexp.md.

autopot.note: AutoPotion implements the AutoPot behavior: at 8 health, it selected and threw one healing splash potion, raising health to 16.5 and restoring the stone slot. Harming potions were ignored. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-potions.md.

autopotion.note: At 8 health, AutoPotion selected and threw one healing splash potion, raising health to 16.5 and restoring the stone slot. Harming potions were ignored. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-potions.md.

throwpot.note: A low-health toggle consumed two healing potions and restored stone; a higher-health toggle consumed one. The module disabled itself after each sequence. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-potions.md.

pot.note: The one-shot hotbar swap threw healing and poison splash potions and a slowness lingering potion on a local 26.3 server, restored stone, and disabled itself. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-pot.md.

autorod.note: With stone selected and a rod in the next hotbar slot, Auto Rod repeatedly hooked and reeled a stationary pig six blocks away. Server rod damage reached 30, consistent with six entity-hook reels at five durability each; the stone slot was restored. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-autorod.md.

autopearl.note: In a local two-player 26.3 test, AutoPearl followed another player's ender pearl, consumed one pearl, landed about 1.4 blocks from that player, and restored the original hotbar slot. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-autopearl.md.

autosoup.note: At 10 health and 11 food on a vanilla 26.3 server, Auto Soup selected mushroom stew, consumed it into a bowl, raised food to 17, and restored the stone slot. Stock soup did not directly heal; soup PvP plugin behavior remains untested. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-soup.md.

soup.note: A K key toggle selected and consumed mushroom stew from hotbar slot 3, raised food from 8 to 14, restored stone in slot 0, and disabled the one-shot module on a vanilla 26.3 server. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-soup.md.

keepsprint.note: A local two-player 26.3 test showed the server's sprint predicate true after a hit with Keep Sprint enabled; the paired control went from true before the hit to false afterward. Local horizontal velocity restoration is implemented but not separately measured. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-sprint-combat.md.

sprintreset.note: A local two-player 26.3 test showed the server's sprint predicate true immediately after a player hit with Sprint Reset enabled, versus false in the paired control. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-sprint-combat.md.

wtap.note: A local paired two-player test showed a server-observed sprint stop and restart and about 0.94 fewer blocks of forward movement at the matched mid-test sample; releasing W during the tap prevented sprint restart. Tested with an 8-tick release for observability; the 2-tick default remains untested. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-wtap.md.

criticals.note: A local vanilla 26.3 server recorded an iron sword hit on a stationary pig for 9 damage with Criticals, versus 6 without it; a low ceiling fell back to 6 damage. Combined with Kill Aura, one isolated hit dealt 9 damage after fixing its early punch packet. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-criticals.md.

surround.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, Surround placed all four cardinal obsidian blocks beside PlayerA, repaired a removed side from hotbar and offhand, restored the stone slot, and centered an offset player from (5.8,100,5.3) to (5.5,100,5.5) before placement. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-surround.md.

holefill.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, Hole Filler placed obsidian at (8,100,5) in a visible safe hole near a pig and restored the selected stone slot. It left the hole empty without a target, with one ordinary-stone wall, and while a pig occupied it. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-holefiller.md.

selftrap.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, Self Trap built a three-block north support column and an obsidian roof at (20,102,20), restored the selected stone slot, rebuilt the roof from offhand obsidian after removal, and left it empty without obsidian. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-selftrap.md.

selfweb.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, Self Web placed a cobweb in PlayerC's feet cell from the hotbar, restored the selected stone slot, replaced a removed web from offhand, and left the cell air after both sources were cleared. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-selfweb.md.

selfanvil.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, Self Anvil refused an open floor, then built two support blocks and dropped an anvil into PlayerC's one-block obsidian hole while restoring stone. At 9.33 health it placed nothing; a cobweb in the feet cell also blocked placement. Removing the cobweb let an anvil land, consuming the item and reducing health from 18 to 16. Offhand use was verified separately. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-selfanvil.md.

antianvil.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, Anti Anvil built an obsidian support and roof at (5,102,5) before a falling anvil landed on top at (5,103,5), keeping PlayerA at 20 health. The disabled control left the roof empty and reduced health to 10; an off-axis anvil triggered no roof. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-antianvil.md.

antibed.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, Anti Bed placed string as tripwire at PlayerC's feet and all four cardinal cells, restored stone, repaired a removed cell from offhand string, and stopped without material. A normal red-bed click failed while two target cells held tripwire, then placed the bed across those cells after the string was cleared. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-antibed.md.

autoanvil.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, Auto Anvil built a side scaffold and dropped an anvil on a helmeted player. A nearly broken helmet disappeared and health fell from 20 to 16; a fresh helmet took 3 durability damage from an offhand anvil and health fell from 20 to 14.096. No-helmet and no-anvil controls placed nothing. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-autoanvil.md.

autotrap.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, Auto Trap built a 12-block obsidian perimeter plus roof around a stationary pig, placed cobweb, fire, and lava in its occupied feet cell in separate runs, restored the selected stone slot, and left a wall gap open after the target was removed. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-autotrap.md.

autododge.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, a no-gravity arrow shot at a stationary survival player caused a 2.15-block Z sidestep and no health loss with Auto Dodge enabled; the paired disabled control dealt 1 damage and X knockback. With one lateral floor missing, the dodge chose the safe side; with both sides missing, it refused the dodge. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-autododge.md.

crystalaura.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, Crystal Aura placed and detonated end crystals from hotbar and offhand against a 100-health pig: the first explosion left 25.208336 health, matching its 74.79 raw-damage estimate; a second detonation killed the pig after the player returned to range. Default survival safety settings placed nothing in the same exposed setup. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-crystalaura.md.

autocrystalbase.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, Auto Crystal Base selected obsidian from the hotbar, placed one useful base at (8,100,5) beside an elevated target, kept stone selected, and Crystal Aura then used it to kill a 100-health pig. Its projected blast score refused a flat-floor base that would shield a ground-level target, and default survival settings refused a dangerous elevated setup. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-autocrystalbase.md.

anchoraura.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, Anchor Aura placed, charged, and detonated one respawn anchor with one glowstone, reducing a pig from 300 to 240.30185 health and consuming both items. It detonated a precharged anchor without items, charged then detonated an uncharged anchor using hotbar or offhand glowstone, and restored the selected stone slot. Default self-damage limits and the Nether dimension guard placed nothing. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-anchoraura.md.

bedaura.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, Bed Aura placed and detonated a bed in survival in both the Nether and End, reducing a 300-health pig to 240.30185 and consuming one bed while restoring the selected stone slot. It also detonated an existing bed without a bed item. In the Overworld or under default self-damage limits it placed nothing. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-bedaura.md.

superknockback.note: The sprint bonus is gameplay verified: a target player moved about 3.62 blocks after the hit versus 1.99 blocks in a paired unsprinted control, with equal damage. Vanilla's damage cooldown still blocks knockback during immune hits; that catalog behavior remains unresolved. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-sprint-combat.md.

bowspam.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, six seconds of held use consumed 15 arrows with an 8-tick bow charge; seven seconds consumed four arrows with a crossbow. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-bowspam.md.

aimassist.note: In a local 26.3 multiplayer world, yaw/pitch changed from 0/0 to -14.04/11.72 while attack was held and a visible mob was within FOV. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-local-gameplay.md.

aimbot.note: In a local 26.3 multiplayer world, yaw/pitch changed from 0/0 to -26.57/10.82 toward a stationary visible mob, without an attack key press. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-local-gameplay.md.

antibot.note: Conservative player-list, entity-age, and optional invisibility filters shared by automatic combat modules; detection against a real anticheat decoy is unverified.

plugins.note: Inventories root commands and namespaces already visible in the server command tree, with no extra packets; hidden commands cannot be seen.

norotate.note: Local 26.3 server /rotate and teleport commands left view unchanged with No Rotate enabled; paired control without the module changed view to the requested angles. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-local-gameplay.md.

noserverrotate.note: Same gameplay-verified No Rotate implementation covers dedicated rotation packets and position corrections. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-local-gameplay.md.

weather.note: Controls the local weather view; server weather remains authoritative.

autowalk.note: Enabled through ImGui in a local Minecraft 26.3 multiplayer world; passive movement samples show Z advancing from -78.5 to -65.3 without manual forward input. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-local-gameplay.md.

autoswim.note: In a local vanilla 26.3 water tunnel, a server-side swimming predicate reported false while Auto Walk moved the player forward with Auto Swim off, true with Auto Swim on, and false again after forward input stopped. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-autoswim.md. Surface behavior and third-party anticheats remain untested.

automend.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, Auto Mend rotated two damaged Mending tools through the offhand as real XP orbs repaired them, stored both repaired tools, and disabled itself. The default setting preserved an offhand totem; force mode temporarily displaced and later restored it while an item blacklist kept a pickaxe untouched. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-automend.md. Full inventories and third-party anticheats remain untested.

autocrafter.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, Auto Crafter made eight sticks in a crafting table and eight torches in the inventory 2x2 grid, cooked and collected iron in furnace and blast furnace menus and beef in a smoker, and respected the Recipe Book-open gate. All four full-inventory actions and an ordered-target loop guard were tested. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-autocrafter.md. Cooking requires preloaded fuel; custom recipes and third-party anticheats remain untested.

safewalk.note: After registering its existing mixin, a local vanilla 26.3 server kept an Auto Walk player at y=100 and a fixed X position at an air edge with Safe Walk enabled and Scaffold disabled. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-scaffold.md.

scaffold.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, Scaffold built a continuous 16-block stone bridge from hotbar material and three more blocks from offhand, restored the selected sword, stopped safely when blocks ran out, and refused to use sand. Optional tower mode built a four-block vertical column and stopped after consuming its material. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-scaffold.md.

nuker.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, Nuker automatically mined three dirt blocks in range, used an iron shovel for exactly three durability points, restored the selected sword, and preserved the dirt underfoot and a stone block excluded by its filter. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-nuker.md.

nukerlegit.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, NukerLegit left occluded and behind-view dirt untouched, then mined each after the obstruction was removed or the player turned toward it. It selected an iron shovel and restored the sword after each block. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-nuker.md.

veinminer.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, a real mouse break triggered Vein Miner to mine the clicked coal ore and three face-connected neighbors, while adjacent stone and disconnected coal ore remained. A new cluster stayed untouched without a click, and max_blocks=2 limited a three-block chain to two mined blocks. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-veinminer.md.

autotunnel.note: Auto Tunnel mined a 2x2x3 stone corridor, repaired two floor gaps, paused before lava, a chest, and overhead sand, resumed after sand removal, and placed a torch at the third segment on a local vanilla 26.3 server. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-autotunnel.md. Longer tunnels and third-party anticheats remain untested.

tunneller.note: Auto Tunnel mined a 2x2x3 stone corridor, repaired two floor gaps, paused before lava, a chest, and overhead sand, resumed after sand removal, and placed a torch at the third segment on a local vanilla 26.3 server. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-autotunnel.md. Longer tunnels and third-party anticheats remain untested.

autoshear.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, Auto Shearer sheared one adult sheep from hotbar shears and again from offhand shears after a reset, leaving a baby untouched and restoring the selected slot. A stone wall and a no-shears control prevented interaction. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-autoshearer.md. Moving targets and third-party anticheats remain untested.

autobreed.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, Auto Breed used two wheat from hotbar to breed sheep and two from offhand to breed cows. Both runs produced a newborn, put the parents in breeding cooldown, and preserved the selected slot; one wheat and a cow-excluding species filter caused no feed. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-autobreed.md. Other species and third-party anticheats remain untested.

automobheal.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, Auto Mob Heal repaired an iron golem from 50 to 100 with two hotbar ingots, fed a tamed horse from 10 to 16 with offhand wheat, an owned wolf from 10 to 40 with offhand beef, and an owned cat from 4 to 8 with offhand cod. It preserved the selected slot, ignored a 99-health golem and another owner's wolf, and respected a stone wall. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-automobheal.md. Other mount variants and third-party anticheats remain untested.

autofarm.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, Auto Farm harvested and replanted mature wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, nether wart, and cocoa; picked sweet berries; mined melons and pumpkins; cut upper cane, cactus, bamboo, and kelp while preserving each base; planted empty farmland; advanced wheat from age 0 to 5 with one bone meal; and left wheat behind a wall untouched until exposed. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-autofarm.md. Protected-region and third-party anticheat behavior remains untested.

automount.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, Auto Mount boarded an oak boat, bamboo raft, minecart, tamed saddled horse, saddled pig and strider, camel, and tamed llama. It ignored a chest boat, unsaddled horse and pig, occluded boat, occupied boat, and a boat when both hands and every hotbar slot were full. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-automount.md. Moving entities and third-party anticheats remain untested.

airplace.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, a real right-click placed floating obsidian, spawned a chicken from an egg, placed an armor stand, and launched a firework rocket at an aimed air position. Offhand placement preserved the selected slot; clicking a real block used its normal face; water remained intact; and fixed range 2 placed at the nearer position. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-airplace.md. A three-dimensional preview and third-party anticheat behavior remain untested or unimplemented.

antiinteract.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, right-clicking a chest, barrel, or blue shulker box left each container-open score at 0. An unlisted crafting table opened, raising its score from 0 to 1. Sneaking placed cobblestone against a chest without opening it. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-antiinteract.md. Other default containers, custom IDs, and third-party anticheats remain untested.

autobrewer.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, Auto Brewer loaded and brewed three strength potions from water bottles, resumed a single awkward potion, left an unrelated healing potion untouched, brewed three splash weakness potions, and turned a preloaded splash weakness potion into a lingering potion while cleaning up the glass-bottle remainder. Its 44 chosen ingredient edges match the vanilla 26.3 recipe provider. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-autobrewer.md. Custom recipes and third-party anticheats remain untested.

autobuild.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, AutoBuild filled all 24 missing cells of a 5x5 stone platform, built and lit a 14-obsidian portal frame, restored the selected hotbar slot, and disabled itself after each build. With no obsidian, it placed nothing and disabled itself. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-autobuild.md. Larger platform radii and third-party anticheats remain untested.

autosmelter.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, Auto Smelter loaded and collected three iron ingots from a furnace, two gold ingots from a blast furnace, and two cooked beef from a smoker. It preserved raw iron when fuel was missing, then resumed with a two-coal refill, closed the menu, and stayed enabled as configured. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-autosmelter.md. Custom recipes, full inventories, and third-party anticheats remain untested.

autonametag.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, Auto Nametag named a sheep and cow with two tags from a hotbar stack, preserved an already named pig, ignored an unnamed tag, named a sheep from the offhand, and left a sheep behind a wall unnamed until the wall was removed. It restored the selected hotbar slot. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-autonametag.md. Moving entities and third-party anticheats remain untested.

endermanlook.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, avoidance mode turned the player 90 degrees away when aimed at an enderman's eyes, while look-at mode turned toward its eyes. A stone wall stopped look-at rotation until removed. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-endermanlook.md. Multiple or moving endermen and third-party anticheats remain untested.

autobreak.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, Auto Break mined a dirt block under the crosshair without a held attack key and left a replacement block intact after the player looked away. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-autobreak.md.

automine.note: Auto Mine's targeted-block behavior is exposed as Auto Break. It mined a dirt block without held attack and stopped after the player looked away on a local vanilla 26.3 server. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-autobreak.md.

durabilityalert.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, a 9%-durability iron helmet caused one chat/log warning, did not repeat immediately, and warned again after a healthy helmet was observed before re-equipping the damaged one. A low-durability held pickaxe did not warn under the armor-only default. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-durabilityalert.md.

inventorycleaner.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, Inventory Cleaner sorted a sword, food, and blocks into configured hotbar slots; merged partial stone stacks; discarded blacklisted rotten flesh and non-whitelisted dirt; replaced a wooden sword with a netherite sword; moved a shield to offhand; and reduced a protected hotbar stack to a 32-block cap. The cap and filter also worked with the inventory screen open, while an ignored hotbar slot stayed untouched. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-inventorycleaner.md. Container screens, all category choices and caps, and third-party anticheats remain untested.

guimove.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, GUI Move forwarded walking and jumping while the inventory was visible, rotated the view with arrow keys, and forwarded sideways movement while a chest stayed open. It respected a rebound forward key, preserved chat typing behavior, and stopped movement when disabled. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-guimove.md. Optional sneak and All-screen modes and third-party anticheats remain untested.

invwalk.note: Inventory Move is exposed as GUI Move. On a local vanilla 26.3 server, the open inventory and chest screens allowed normal movement, an inventory jump, and a rebound forward key; chat and a disabled control did not move. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-guimove.md. Advanced server-side-close and packet-queue modes from other clients are not implemented.

anticheatdetect.note: AntiCheat Detect compares passive command-tree and payload names with five source-backed signatures, shows possible candidates and evidence in both profile GUIs, and can announce candidates in chat. A real vanilla 26.3 session with a deliberate post-join teleport stayed unknown while displaying the correction count; direct Java and Python probes covered positive signatures and generic negatives. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-anticheatdetect.md. Identification against a real anticheat server remains unverified.

offhand.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, Offhand swapped a totem into the offhand, fell back to crystals without totems, restored a displaced shield after low health and nearby-crystal danger cleared, selected crystals, enchanted apples, strength potions, and non-falling blocks through bound mode keys, and moved from strength potion to golden apple when Strength became active during a Kill Aura sword context. With Eagle enabled, Auto mode equipped stone. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-offhand.md and docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-eagle.md. Fall prediction, primed creepers, Crystal Aura and Scaffold contexts, and third-party anticheats remain untested.

eagle.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, at an isolated one-block platform with edge distance 0.2, Eagle's client input produced a growing server sneak_time score at x=50.83 while the score stopped at block center. Holding forward for two seconds moved the player only to x=51.2974 while y=120 and health=20 remained intact. Offhand Auto equipped stone while Eagle was enabled. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-eagle.md. Conditional movement/held-block/pitch settings, complex block shapes, and third-party anticheats remain untested.

elytraswap.note: On a local vanilla 26.3 server, bound key presses swapped a diamond chestplate with an inventory elytra and back, swapped the same pair through the offhand, preferred a fresh elytra over one with 2 durability left, refused the worn-only wing, preserved a Binding Curse chestplate, equipped an elytra into an empty chest slot, and chose a netherite chestplate over leather. The saved module state returned to false after each action. See docs/test-evidence/2026-10-30-elytraswap.md. Open menus, full inventories, and third-party anticheats remain untested.
